title: RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users' real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. translated_title: RecipeADQA：一个面向多约束食谱推荐的用户感知问答数据集
translated_abstract: 面向食谱推荐的问答任务缺乏带有真实标签（ground-truth）的数据集。现有方法通常通过食材或标签约束的简单组合来生成数据集，导致表达不自然、约束不合理，难以反映用户的真实偏好。本文提出了一种用于构建自然语言食谱推荐基准式问答数据集的方法。该方法以真实用户行为为驱动，整合外部用户查询与评论数据，利用大语言模型（LLM）提取细粒度偏好信号，并将其映射到基于知识图谱的标签模式上，从而构建出由偏好约束和食材约束组成的问答数据。此外，该方法还采用贪心策略进行约束选择以控制答案规模，并应用基于标签的重排序来提升数据质量。生成的数据集RecipeADQA包含自然语言问题、结构化约束以及……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了RecipeADQA——一个以真实用户行为为驱动、利用大语言模型提取细粒度偏好信号并映射到知识图谱标签模式上的多约束食谱推荐基准问答数据集，同时通过贪心约束选择策略和基于标签的重排序保证数据质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RecipeADQA, a benchmark-style QA dataset for multi-constraint recipe recommendation driven by real user behavior, where LLMs extract fine-grained preference signals mapped onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, with greedy constraint selection and tag-based re-ranking to ensure data quality.
